title: Fovea tour bundle
description: JSON shape for a tour script in $FOVEA_TOURS_DIR (custom-tour loader) and for the per-tour fixture bundles under annotation-tool/demo/fixtures/. See docs/tours.md and docs/tour-anchors.md.

id.description: Stable identifier. Used by the menu, the runner, deep-links from the marketing site, and the seed handler. Match the bundle filename (tour-{id}.json) so each tour has one file in each layer.

title.description: Display title for the tile + the step card header. Keep under ~50 chars.

description.description: One-sentence pitch for the tile. Plain text. Renders inside the CardDescription.

durationMinutes.description: Approximate run time in minutes. Surfaces as a badge on the tile.

tags.description: Feature-area chips that surface alongside the duration badge.

fixtureBundle.description: Optional. If set, the demo runner POSTs to /api/demo/seed with this id before painting step 1 (fixture mode).

recap.description: Plain-text recap surfaced on /done/:id after the tour completes.

followUpTourId.description: Optional. Tour id to suggest on the recap page.

steps.description: Tour scripts. Built-in tours land in src/tours/scripts/; custom tours under $FOVEA_TOURS_DIR can also include this. Fixture bundles MUST NOT include steps (the bundle is workspace state, the script is what runs against it).

personas.description: Fixture bundle field. Each persona is created against the anonymous demo user when /api/demo/seed runs.

videos.description: Fixture bundle field. References videos already in demo CDN storage by id; the seeder doesn't upload.

annotations.description: Fixture bundle field. Pre-existing annotations the tour starts from. Currently accepted as untyped pass-through; the loader lands incrementally.

summaries.description: Fixture bundle field. Pre-existing transcripts + summaries for Tour 7. Currently accepted as untyped pass-through.

anchor.description: Stable data-tour-id value (no [data-tour-id="..."] wrapping). See docs/tour-anchors.md.

narration.description: ≤ 15 words. The step card is a caption, not a manual.

body.description: Optional secondary text rendered under the narration.

requiresFixture.description: True if the step depends on demo-seeded state. Anchored mode shows a graceful 'demo content' note and lets the user skip.

expectAction.description: Informational. Not enforced by the engine; used by telemetry + by self-hosters authoring tours.

modal.description: Force modal click-blocking on this step regardless of the tour-level default.

informationNeed.description: Free-form description. Defaults to 'Demo persona.' if omitted.

isDefault.description: Optional UI hint that this is the active persona.

personaIndex.description: Index into personas[]; the ontology attaches to that persona.

gloss.description: Plain-text definition. The seeder wraps it in a single-segment GlossItem array on write.
